description: Implementation of the scheduler logic for a wireless communication system, including handling cell configuration, UE management, and various indication messages.

classes.name: scheduler_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing scheduler functionalities for managing cells, UEs, and handling messages.

methods.name: handle_cell_configuration_request
methods.description: Handles configuration requests for cells, creating cell schedulers and UE groups as needed.

methods.name: handle_cell_removal_request
methods.description: Removes a cell from the scheduler.

methods.name: handle_cell_activation_request
methods.description: Activates a cell in the scheduler.

methods.name: handle_cell_deactivation_request
methods.description: Deactivates a cell in the scheduler.

methods.name: handle_slice_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Reconfigures a slice of a cell.

methods.name: handle_si_update_request
methods.description: Updates scheduling information for a cell.

methods.name: handle_ue_creation_request
methods.description: Creates a new UE configuration and dispatches it to the appropriate UE scheduler.

methods.name: handle_ue_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Reconfigures an existing UE.

methods.name: handle_ue_removal_request
methods.description: Removes a UE from the scheduler.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Handles event when UE configuration is applied.

methods.name: handle_ue_deactivation_request
methods.description: Handles UE deactivation requests.

methods.name: handle_rach_indication
methods.description: Processes RACH indication messages.

methods.name: handle_ul_bsr_indication
methods.description: Processes UL BSR indication messages.

methods.name: handle_ul_phr_indication
methods.description: Processes UL PHR indication messages.

methods.name: handle_dl_buffer_state_indication
methods.description: Handles DL buffer state indications.

methods.name: handle_crc_indication
methods.description: Handles CRC indication messages.

methods.name: handle_uci_indication
methods.description: Handles UCI indication messages.

methods.name: handle_srs_indication
methods.description: Handles SRS indication messages.

methods.name: handle_dl_mac_ce_indication
methods.description: Handles DL MAC C/E indication messages.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Runs scheduler for a specific slot and returns the result.

methods.name: handle_error_indication
methods.description: Handles error indications during slot processing.

methods.name: handle_paging_information
methods.description: Processes paging information for cells.

methods.name: handle_positioning_measurement_request
methods.description: Handles positioning measurement requests.

methods.name: handle_positioning_measurement_stop
methods.description: Handles stopping of positioning measurements.
